title: Semantic audio features
description: Implement M0–M5 from the accepted semantic audio plan. Ground CLAP audio analysis and clustering; browser CLAP text encoding; serverless native DynamoDB vector retrieval; related audio; hybrid search; published cluster exploration. All six epic specifications precede implementation. Terra implements bounded packets; supervisor verifies and integrates. No cloud encoder, replacement embedding model, manual deployment, or release. Independent rollout gates and measured compatibility, relevance, latency, and visibility protection are required.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Partial delivery on develop: all six epic specifications, stories and bounded task packets; reliable semantic region identities and deterministic ground sidecars; isolated browser/evaluation diagnostics. M0 actual q8 parity fails required 0.98 for bass 0.9776231 and metal 0.9740588, despite matching token IDs/masks. M1–M5 remain open and undispatched. No semantic search, related lists or clustering UI implemented yet. Await supervision direction on a same-model higher-precision browser evaluation; no substitute model, relaxed threshold, cloud inference or deployment authorized. Raw measurements and reproduction commands are in design/semantic-audio.md and fixtures/semantic-audio/browser-parity-preflight.json.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Goal resumed: complete the requested semantic audio initiative, not the harness. User should test real Apricity search with the existing library; supervisor handles all engineering fixtures/evaluations. Same-model fp32 WASM compatibility investigation is authorized as precision correction, thresholds unchanged. Canonical record/publication preparation runs in parallel read-only. Production release/deployment and mobile/listening/cloud sandbox acceptance remain explicit, not silently assumed.
